Andhra Pradesh to establish first semiconductor plant with ₹2,387 crore investment

Andhra Pradesh is set to establish its first semiconductor plant near Visakhapatnam, with an investment of ₹2,387 crore. The facility, located at Tarluvada, will focus on chip assembly and testing. This project is part of the state's initiative under the India Semiconductor Mission and is expected to generate 1,000 jobs. The state has also amended its semiconductor policy to offer subsidies of up to 80% for silicon fab projects.
